bias.zh: 看空 · 跌破 $62 和 $59.3 支撑

read.en: Applied Optoelectronics fell 7.3% on Nov 4 to $59.27, trading between $57.29 and $64.13. It is below the falling 5-day ($66.80), 10-day ($70.07), 30-day ($89.63) and 100-day ($111.02) averages and the rising 200-day ($114.54). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 13 and below zero, histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 12 ($76.29), and RSI is 32.
read.zh: Applied Optoelectronics 11月4日下跌 7.3%，收于 $59.27，盘中区间 $57.29–64.13。股价位于下行的 5 日（$66.80）、10 日（$70.07）、30 日（$89.63）和 100 日均线（$111.02）以及上行的 200 日均线（$114.54）下方。MACD 自 10月13日起位于信号线下方且在零轴之下，柱状图扩大；抛物线 SAR 自 10月12日起看空（$76.29），RSI 为 32。

read.en: The close broke the $61.9–62.3 support and the $59.3 Feb 25 high, after a high of $64.13 under the broken $66 area. Resistance is $61.9–64.1 (Nov 2–3 lows, Nov 4 high), then $66.3–66.8 (Oct 22 low, 5-day) and $70.1–71.6 (10-day, Nov 2 high). Support is $57.3 (Nov 4 low), then $50.8 (Feb 11 high). A close above $64.1 would target $66–67; below $57.3, $51.
